name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free, run-it-yourself alternative to ElevenLabs that clones voices, designs new ones, dubs videos into other languages, and turns speech into text — all without sending your voice data to a cloud company.
buyer: An independent audiobook narrator or small dubbing studio that wants ElevenLabs-quality voice tools without the recurring subscription cost or sending client audio to a third party.
business_use_cases: A podcast network uses it to auto-dub episodes into multiple languages without paying per-minute cloud TTS fees.
An audiobook publisher clones a narrator's voice once and generates unlimited chapters without re-booking studio time.
A course creator uses local dictation and voice cloning to produce narrated lessons entirely offline, cheaply.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a done-for-you dubbing/voice-cloning service for indie podcasters and course creators built on this tool, priced per project.
Run it as a hosted SaaS with a simple upload-and-generate interface for non-technical creators, billed by usage.

steal_this: This weekend, offer a 'dub your podcast into Spanish' service on Fiverr using this tool to clone the host's voice and generate the translated audio.
